contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [IMP CONSTAN]TINVS P F AVG ; R/ [SOLI INVIC]-TO COMITI

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantine I (306-337), Soli Invicto issue of 316, Reece period 15; Arles mint, RIC vol. 7 no. 72. Obverse description: Bust laureate draped and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [IMP CONSTAN]TINVS P F AVG. Reverse description: Sol standing left with whip and globe. T F in field. Reverse inscription: [SOLI INVIC]-TO COMITI. In exergue: probably PARL. Diameter: 18.53 mm, Thickness: 2.09 mm; Weight: 2.71, die axis: 6
